data.why: The repo ships no bundled example dataset; a synthetic 10x Matrix Market triplet (matrix.mtx + features.tsv + barcodes.tsv, 20 genes x 15 cells) matches the format read by src/components/NewAnalysis/MatrixMarketCard.js, including a high-count outlier cell, several normal cells, a near-empty droplet (1 count) and a fully empty droplet (0 counts) to exercise QC filtering.

goals: Upload a count matrix (Matrix Market or h5ad) and run the standard client-side analysis: QC filtering, normalization, PCA, clustering, and dimensionality reduction
Inspect the t-SNE/UMAP embedding and identify discrete cell clusters
Rank and inspect marker genes for a selected cluster to characterize cell identity
Make a custom cell selection on the embedding and detect markers specific to that selection
Annotate clusters with cell-type labels using a reference dataset
Export the analysis state as a .kana file or save it to the browser for later restoration

review.summary: The tree gets kana's core path right, from upload through settings for each step, running the pipeline, markers and export, in tool-neutral wording and at a sensible depth. But it leaves out custom selections, cell-type annotation and saving and restoring an analysis, which the README treats as central. A few cited screens (026, 037, and the ZIP size) don't show what their nodes claim, so it needs fixes before filing.
